claim: No part of the Collatz conjecture is proved by this harness.
graduation_rule: A future invariant can graduate only if it is eps-sensitive, names its false-world falsifier, has an exact checker, and does not convert finite silence into universal theorem language.

probes.candidate: Use survivor counts, densities, entropy, or tau tails to exclude all positive counterexamples.
probes.name: parity_word_statistics
probes.next_action: Every future proof sketch must state which non-word, eps-sensitive quantity it uses.
probes.proof_use: Do not use as a universal proof route.
probes.reason: The q=3 word system is identical for eps=+1 and eps=-1, but the 3n-1 sibling has positive frontier residents 1, 5, and 17.

probes.candidate: Treat tau-infinity / long-frontier residency as a calibrated counterexample detector.
probes.name: frontier_resident_detector
probes.next_action: Keep this as a required control in every new invariant run.
probes.proof_use: Useful falsifier and regression test; not a proof by silence.
probes.reason: The detector fires exactly on the known 3n-1 cycle minima in the available scan and fires at the expected high density in 5n+1.

probes.candidate: Use the sign of the affine intercept to separate where cycles can live.
probes.name: cycle_side_sign_rule
probes.next_action: Use this as the baseline theorem in a formal sibling-control note.
probes.proof_use: Good theorem component; insufficient alone for Collatz.
probes.reason: All known sibling cycles obey the exact rule: eps=+1 cycles sit below the critical line; eps=-1 cycles sit above it.

probes.candidate: Use tau/sigma inequality direction as the first eps-sensitive lint test.
probes.falsifier: Any proof that implies the same tau/sigma theorem for both signs.
probes.name: tau_sigma_direction
probes.next_action: Add this question to every future claim manifest: where does eps=+1 enter?
probes.proof_use: Good proof-sketch lint; it catches sign-blind arguments early.
probes.reason: The sign theorem gives opposite inequality directions: eps=+1 allows threshold traps, eps=-1 gives unconditional descent once tau fires.

probes.candidate: Use finite phase matching alone to block regeneration.
probes.falsifier: Phase-collision lab itself: gate density remains high.
probes.name: phase_gate_only
probes.next_action: Mine odd-unit locks, codimension, positivity, or retimed reserve source instead.
probes.proof_use: Useful negative result; not a proof route by itself.
probes.reason: The exact phase identity checks out, but the finite phase gate is too permissive: it allows roughly three quarters of source-target residues.

probes.candidate: Use no detected Collatz residents in a finite scan as proof of emptiness.
probes.falsifier: Any larger finite bound is still finite.
probes.name: finite_scan_silence
probes.next_action: Convert silence into certified bounded statements only.
probes.proof_use: Evidence and regression signal only; never theorem language.
probes.reason: The Collatz scan is silent in the loaded finite artifact, but the same harness shows exactly how false worlds announce themselves.

probes.candidate: Promote retimed reserve-source records into bounded theorem obligations.
probes.falsifier: A deeper lift or solver counterexample violating the reserve-source checks.
probes.name: retimed_reserve_source
probes.next_action: Encode this finite grammar in SAT/SMT or a proof assistant before adding stronger prose.
probes.proof_use: Strong finite structure; needs induction or solver certificate.
probes.reason: The loaded reserve-source artifact has all depth checks true, 13,856 retimed transitions, and 511 local grammar records.

summary.best_next_move: Formalize the sibling sign theorem and encode retimed reserve-source records as bounded certificates; mine phase odd-unit locks next.
